 MR MAULIK S SHETH(3586) for the Applicant(s) No. 1  MS KRINA CALLA, LD.ADDL. PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the Respondent(s)

ORAL ORDER 1. Learned advocate Mr.Mohit P. Pathak submits that he has instructions to appear on behalf of the respondent no.2 - complainant.
He is permitted to file his appearance.
Registry shall accept his vakalatnama.

2. By way of preferring the present application under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the applicant-accused seeks to invoke the inherent powers of this Court, praying to quash and set-aside the First Information Report being C.R.No.I- 11209041230962 of 2023 registered with the Prantij Police Station, Sabarkantha, for the offences punishable under Sections 120(B), 406, 420, 418, 465, 467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, as well as all other consequential proceedings arising pursuant thereto.

Today, when the matter is called out, the complainant, who is personally present before this Court, has produced his identity proof as well as the affidavit, which are ordered to be taken on record.

In the affidavit, the complainant has categorically stated that with the intervention of the friends, family members and community people, the dispute between him and the applicant-accused has been amicably resolved and there is no ill-will or any grievance amongst them.
4. Considering the issue involved in the present application as well as considering the fact that the dispute has been amicably resolved between the parties, with the consent of the learned advocates appearing for the respective parties, the present application is taken up for final disposal.
5.
RULE returnable forthwith.

Learned APP Ms.Krina Calla waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent no.1 - State and learned advocate Mr.Mohit P. Pathak waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent no.2 - complainant.

6. Learned advocate for the applicant-accused has submitted that since the dispute has been amicably resolved between the parties, the application may be allowed and the impugned FIR may be quashed and set-aside.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/26513/2025 ORDER DATED: 05/03/2026 undefined 7.
The complainant, who is personally present in the Court, has categorically stated that he has no objection if the application is allowed and the impugned FIR is quashed and set-aside.
Thus, it appears from the aforesaid that sending the applicant-accused to face the trial would be nothing but a futile exercise and would amount to abuse of process of law.

8. The relevant paragraphs of the affidavit of the complainant, read thus :
"1. say that I am the first informant and at my behest one FIR came to be lodged against the applicant with Prantij Police Station vide CR I No. 11209041230962 of 2023 on 21.10.2023 under Sections 120(B), 406, 420, 418, 465, 467, 468 & 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and hence I am conversant with the facts of the case and competent to file this affidavit.

2. I further state that after the registration of the FIR, the dispute between me and the present applicant is settled and now no dispute remains and therefore I thought it fit to settle the dispute amicably and to file this affidavit in support of the application for quashing of the FIR lodged by me.

Therefore I would prefer not to step in to witness box and to give evidence against the applicant neither I wish that the precious time of the Hon'ble Court be wasted in a matter which has already been conceded and further I think it is fit to withdraw all the allegations made in the FIR as well as in other further connected NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/26513/2025 Bhavesh Hasmukhlal Bhavsar vs State Of Gujarat on 5 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66274814/
2 ORDER DATED: 05/03/2026 undefined proceedings before the police authorities &
other concerned authorities in the interest of justice.
3. I state and submit that after lodging the aforesaid FIR it was found that the present applicant who has been arraigned as accused in the FIR has no role in the alleged offences and who has been falsely accused out of misunderstanding.

sentences.text: I say and submit that the applicant has not done anything wrong, illegal or anything as alleged in the FIR.
4. I state and submit that I have no more grievance against the partition deed dated 03.12.2020, as well as, qua the revenue entry no.1921 dated 07.12.2021 mutated pursuant thereto.
I further state and submit that the entire land in question has not been sold and that the applicant has sold his undivided share only.

I am hereby unconditionally confirming the sale transaction entered into between the sellers which include original accused no.1, no. 3 to 9 and no.12-13 in favour of the purchaser i.e., the original accused no.14 vide registered sale deed no.753/2021 dated 01.06.2021.
I hereby also confirm the revenue entry no.1946 dated 06.09.2021 mutated pursuant to the said sale deed.

It is stated and submitted that the dispute amongst the family members which includes the present applicant has been settled with monetary compensation and I state that I no longer wish to proceed with the proceedings in connection with the impugned FIR, nor do I wish to initiate any fresh litigation qua the present dispute.
5. I further state and submit that the applicant who has approached this Hon'ble Court for quashing of the FIR and proceedings pursuant to the said FIR; I NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/26513/2025 ORDER DATED: 05/03/2026 undefined have no objection if the present application is allowed and if the aforesaid FIR and consequential proceedings are quashed and set aside qua the present applicant.
6. I say and submit that the FIR was filed because of attending circumstances prevailing at the relevant point of time, but thereafter the dispute with the applicant has been settled and therefore I have no objection if the FIR lodged by me is quashed and set aside.

I, the deponent herein, further submit that the dispute is amicably resolved and I voluntarily and unconditionally withdraw all the allegations made in the FIR as well in the consequential proceedings before the concerned authorities in the interest of justice.
7.

That what is stated hereinabove is true and correct and I am filing this affidavit in support of this application on my own wish and volition without there being any force, pressure, coercion, or any undue influence from anyone."

9.
